title: CISA Adds Exploited Langflow and Trend Micro Apex One Vulnerabilities to KEV
summary: The U.S. Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency (CISA) on Thursday added two security flaws impacting Langflow and Trend Micro Apex One to its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities (KEV) catalog, citing evidence of active exploitation.

title: Cisco Patches CVSS 10.0 Secure Workload REST API Flaw Enabling Data Access
